description: This file defines an evaluation framework for testing AI bot responses, including classes for configuration and running evaluations, and functions to execute evaluation pipelines with audio and language model integrations.

classes.name: EvalConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for evaluation prompts and settings.

classes.name: EvalRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for executing evaluation tests, managing results, and saving audio recordings.

methods.name: function_assert_eval
methods.description: Asynchronously asserts evaluation result and updates LLM frame.

methods.name: assert_eval
methods.description: Sets the future result of the evaluation.

methods.name: run_eval
methods.description: Runs an evaluation on a specified example file with given configuration.

methods.name: save_audio
methods.description: Saves audio bytes to a WAV file with specified sample rate and channels.
